uptime.math: 5 endpoints use the Starter plan's 20 monitors, 20 components and one page. The plan costs $30 a month for 60-second checks.
25 endpoints use the Pro plan's 50 monitors, 50 components and page allowance. The plan costs $100 a month for 60-second checks.
The $500 Scale plan plus 5 monitor packs at $15 each comes to $575 a month. 100 monitors and 500 components cover the 60-second checks.
